name: branding-orange-gridded-stacked-wordmark
title: Gridded Stacked Wordmark on Orange
whatItIs: A black sans wordmark 'WOOD MOOD' stacked in two rows with each letter in its own cell, separated by thin vertical lines and a horizontal rule with dots at the crossings, on a flat orange field.
whatItMeans: The rhyme of WOOD/MOOD is made visible: only the first letter changes, and the grid frames it like a lab table or a game board. Orange and black are punchy and craft-like.
techniques: Place each letter in a ruled cell to expose the modular structure
Stack near-identical words so the single change stands out
Dot markers at line intersections as detail
Two-color palette only, flat and high contrast
Slight tilt on the first letter to create character

vocabulary.definition: Letters set inside boxes formed by ruled lines.
A name split over multiple lines forming a block.
A logo built from two words differing by one letter.
